scenario: The rounding members of `math` per LEXP.3.2 -- `math.floor`, `math.ceil`, `math.trunc` and `math.sign`, reached by `import math` ([LIMP.3.3.4]) -- compile cleanly. Pins the full rounding set in one fixture. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no lowering is read, and no value is evaluated.
rules_ds:
import math

schema Sensor scope logical:
    v: Float key

rule r:
    Sensor s where math.floor(s.v) > 2 and math.ceil(s.v) > 2 and math.trunc(s.v) > 0 and math.sign(s.v) > 0
->
    log info "x"
